messages:
Jun Park: hi all, new hire here (Jun). Running through the observability checklist and hit a snag: the Grafana dashboard link in the Runbooks playbook gives 404 when opened from the playbook iframe, but opens fine when I go to Grafana directly. Anyone know who fixes playbook links?
Hannah (devex): welcome Jun! :wave: can you paste the playbook link and the grafana url you clicked? is this the incident runbook or onboarding checklist?
Jun Park: playbook is /playbooks/observability/runbooks and link is https://grafana.redwood.example/d/olduid/prod-service-overview. When embedded in the playbook iframe it shows "panel not found", clicking the link in a new tab opens the dashboard but panels 403 sometimes.
Luca (obs-eng): hey Jun, that sounds like either a UID mismatch after an import or folder-level permission (embed vs view). If the dashboard was reimported it might have a new UID and the playbook link is stale. What email are you using for SSO?
Jun Park: jun.park@redwood.ai. Also saw a note about a grafana group `redwood-observability-viewers` in the playbook but i don't see it in my profile.
Hannah (devex): i can do a quick membership check. @DevEx Bot can you open ticket to add jun.park@redwood.ai to redwood-observability-viewers and update the playbook link if needed?
DevEx Bot: Created ticket #DX-3510 - "Grafana: add jun.park@redwood.ai to redwood-observability-viewers; validate runbooks links". Assignee: Hannah. ETA: 1 business day.
Luca (obs-eng): I'll also grep the dashboard import logs. If UID changed I can add a redirect and update the playbook. Meanwhile, try Grafana Home > Dashboards > Browse > Production > Prod Service Overview and use the Share > direct link to panel. That usually bypasses iframe auth.
Jun Park: thanks 60a. quick extra items while we're here: 1) Datadog CLI returns "Forbidden" when i try to create an app key (`datadog app-key create --name jun-cli`), 2) Sentry only shows my personal sandbox org, not the `services` projects. who owns those?
Hannah (devex): Datadog app key creation can be restricted; infra might need to grant you `observability-cli` or create the app key on your behalf. For Sentry obs-eng usually manages org team membership. I'll add both asks to #DX-3510.
DevEx Bot: Updated #DX-3510: Added subtask - "Create Datadog app key for jun.park@redwood.ai" and "Add Jun to Sentry projects: services-backend, services-worker".
Luca (obs-eng): Jun, can you confirm the repo names or project slugs you need in Sentry? I can map from repos.
Jun Park: repos: github.com/redwood/services-backend and github.com/redwood/services-worker; project slugs probably services-backend and services-worker.
Luca (obs-eng): noted. I added you to the Sentry team and queued the Datadog app key request with infra. Sentry access should be visible within ~2 hours. Datadog app key depends on infra approval (EOD).
Jun Park: tried Grafana link again after clearing cache and it works in the iframe! Panels load now. Sentry also shows the two projects. Thanks so much.
Hannah (devex): awesome. I'll keep #DX-3510 open until Datadog app key is ready. If anything else blocks your runbook walkthrough ping me. Welcome aboard! :tada:
